description: Author and update a Claude Code plugin's human-facing documentation from the plugin's actual current state, then invoke human-doc-reviewer for QA.

evals.name: Author a new README from scratch
evals.prompt: Using the plugin-documentation skill, write a README.md for the plugin at evals/plugin-documentation/fixture-plugin (no README.md exists there yet).
evals.expected_output: README.md at evals/plugin-documentation/fixture-plugin/README.md describing widget-tools, listing both hello-skill and goodbye-skill with their actual descriptions, an install command, and a license line — with no invented capabilities.

evals.name: Update existing README without dropping human-added content
evals.prompt: Using the plugin-documentation skill, update the README.md at evals/plugin-documentation/fixture-plugin-eval2 to reflect that the plugin now has two skills (hello-skill and goodbye-skill), not just one.
evals.expected_output: README.md updated to list both skills, while the existing 'Known Issues' section and its content are preserved unchanged.

evals.name: Author a doc type outside human-doc-reviewer's scope
evals.prompt: Using the plugin-documentation skill, write a QUICK_START.md for the plugin at evals/plugin-documentation/fixture-plugin-eval3.
evals.expected_output: QUICK_START.md written with install step + one usage example, and the final report explicitly states no dedicated reviewer is available for this doc type yet.
